search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Microsoft/Office365 Workload
| json "Workload" 
| timeslice 1d
| count _timeslice, workload 
| transpose row _timeslice column workload

children.name: Office 365 - Azure Active Directory - Operations Trends

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Microsoft/Office365 "\"Workload\":\"AzureActiveDirectory\"" "Operation"
| json "Workload", "Operation" 
| where workload = "AzureActiveDirectory"
| timeslice by 1d
| count _timeslice, operation 
| transpose row _timeslice column operation

_sourceCategory = Labs/Microsoft/Office365 "\"Workload\":\"Exchange\"" "Operation"
| json "Workload","Operation"
| where workload = "Exchange"
| timeslice by 1d
| count _timeslice, operation 
| transpose row _timeslice column operation

children.name: Office 365 - Sharepoint or OneDrive - Operations Trends

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Microsoft/Office365 ("\"Workload\":\"SharePoint\"" or "\"Workload\":\"OneDrive\"") "Operation"
| json "Workload", "Operation"
| where workload in ("SharePoint","OneDrive")
| timeslice by 1d
| count _timeslice, operation 
| transpose row _timeslice column operation
